name: Precalculus: An Investigation of Functions (David Lippman and Melonie Rasmussen)
goodFor: A function-centred precalculus text including trigonometry, with exercises and answers.

evidence.quote: This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License .
The detailed solutions manual was contributed by Shoreline Community College and Evergreen State College, and is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial ShareAlike License .

notes: The book's home page states CC BY-SA 4.0 for the book but puts its detailed solutions manual under a NonCommercial licence. The 2nd edition PDF's front matter (read, not rechecked, since the recheck tool can't read a PDF) says portions of chapter 3 were remixed from Stitz and Zeager's College Algebra, originally CC BY-SA-NC, used with permission, and that chapter 9 contains content from OpenStax's Precalculus, which Ceder leaves out; it also marks selected exercises [UW] from a GFDL work. Those portions aren't marked in the page text, so the part that qualifies can't be cleanly bounded. The PDF also allows small portions (under 10%) to be remixed into CC-BY, CC-BY-SA-NC or GFDL works. Link only. The book itself is otherwise a good lower-division text. The site has no terms-of-use page; none was found. A LibreTexts copy was not read.
